verdict.rationale: Store Sync is PayPal's own documented path for making a merchant's full product catalog discoverable by AI agents, and partner on-ramps (Wix, Cymbio, BigCommerce/Feedonomics, Shopware) are offered for connecting product listings. However, the evidence does not show the actual feed format or import API spec, access is form-gated rather than self-serve, and scope is limited to US physical goods in USD. missing for 10: a documented feed/import API specification for catalog ingestion, self-serve access, support for digital goods/subscriptions/non-US sales, and independent or hands-on corroboration of catalog discovery working in agent surfaces.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can publish my product or service catalog into agent surfaces through a documented feed or import API so AI agents can discover what I sell

citations.quote: It connects your product catalog and commerce API with PayPal's agentic commerce services, enabling AI agents to discover your products
Store Sync is for merchants who want to make their full product catalog and order management accessible to AI shopping assistants.
Connect your product listings to PayPal's partners like Wix, Cymbio, Commerce (BigCommerce & Feedonomics), and Shopware to make your products easy for customers to find and buy.
Store Sync currently supports merchants who are selling physical goods to US-based customers in USD.
